The `docs/selfhost.md` "what is not proven" paragraph no longer calls `islo use --init minimal` unsettled: it now records that `--init minimal` does execute the repo-root `islo.yaml` setup script, that under the former six-host allowlist the `uv` install died with `curl: (22) The requested URL returned error: 403`, that the cause is the `astral.sh` installer's redirect to `releases.astral.sh` and its GitHub-asset fallback to `release-assets.githubusercontent.com`, and the observation stamp (2026-09-27, islo CLI 0.53.1) — while preserving the adjacent unproven claims (no real-model run via `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, no islo run via `ISLO_API_KEY`, no merged self-authored pull request). Only the three declared files were touched; no protected path was modified. I verified each edit against the pinned assertions in tests/test_doctor.py:276-299 by reading the final text (the deploy.sh `allow:`-to-`islo environment create` slice, the two islo.md rows, and selfhost.md's required/forbidden substrings), but this environment exposes no shell tool, so I could not execute `uv run --group dev pytest` to confirm the suite green.
